title: Confidential AI & GPU TEE Architecture: NVIDIA H200/Blackwell CC-On, PPCIE Multi-GPU NVLink & Remote Attestation Benchmark

workload_assumptions.gpu_node: 8x NVIDIA H200 / B200 Confidential VM (SEV-SNP / TDX)
workload_assumptions.compliance_standard: Zero-Trust Cloud Data-in-Use Encryption + Remote Attestation

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive GPU `CC-On` with Frequent Host-DRAM KV Swapping & Eager Mode (`SWIOTLB` Bounce Bottleneck)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Encrypting/decrypting KV swap buffers & 650 eager kernel args over PCIe cuts throughput by 53.5%!

tiers.name: Tier 2: Single-GPU `CC-On` (`TP=1`) + CUDA Graph + 100% HBM-Resident KV (Zero Host KV Swap)
tiers.verdict: Only 6.2% TEE tax because only tiny token IDs cross PCIe! Limited to single-GPU models (<=70B on 1x H200)

tiers.name: Tier 3: Multi-GPU H200 `PPCIE` (`TP=8` Encrypted NVLink + CUDA Graph + Attested KMS Weight Decryption)
tiers.verdict: Best Hopper multi-GPU TEE: 95.2% bare-metal speed (only 4.8% TEE overhead) with full 8-GPU NVLink encryption

tiers.name: Tier 4: Blackwell B200 Native Line-Rate TEE (`PCIe TDISP + Inline NVLink 5 Encryption Engines` + Attested KMS)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: Hardware inline encryption engines cut TEE tax to 1.6% (98.4% bare-metal speed) at $0.28/1M
